scope: Four primary-source conservation references. Map actions select a broad existing planning region, not an entrance, precise location or wildlife observation. Listings do not establish an AVES partnership, certification, booking or measured impact.

records.name: El Dorado conservation area · Fundación ProAves
records.location: Minca and Cerro Kennedy, Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta
records.description: ProAves describes forest protection and restoration here. Its visitor offer is now presented as El Dorado Rainforest Resort; confirm access and arrangements directly.

records.name: Reserva ProAves Reinita Cielo Azul
records.description: A ProAves forest reserve on the western slope of the Eastern Andes. The published approach requires reviewing local transport and road conditions with the operator.

records.name: BirdLife Australia Discovery Centre
records.location: Sydney Olympic Park, New South Wales
records.description: BirdLife describes a bird education centre beside Newington Nature Reserve, with a library and education room. Check current visitor arrangements with BirdLife.

records.name: BirdLife Australia Gluepot Reserve
records.description: A conservation reserve with public visitor information. Its manager publishes route restrictions and closures. Review those notices before planning the approach.
